title: A “Perspectival” Mirror of the Elephant: Investigating Language Bias on Google, ChatGPT, YouTube, and Wikipedia

bias_targets.methodology: Translating complex terms (e.g., Buddhism, Liberalism) into 12 different languages, retrieving top results from Google, YouTube, Wikipedia, and ChatGPT, and quantitatively measuring information discrepancies across language pairs using TF-IDF and cosine similarity.

Qualitative content analysis of search results, encyclopedia articles, and LLM outputs across different languages to identify ethnocentric perspectives, local dominant viewpoints, and varying topical coverage tied to specific cultural communities.
Evaluating the ideological framing and censorship of political figures (e.g., Dalai Lama) and ideologies (e.g., Liberalism, Marxism) in digital platforms' outputs across different language queries.
